name: foxnne NAT III clouds (pass 5, closed skies)
author: foxnne
description: DRAFT, pass 5, not tested in game as a pack. Per-weather, per-period sky ONLY for closed skies: overcast and fog (pass-4 values, approved), rain and storm (pass-4 values, not reviewed), snow (the approved overcast deck + a day exposure raise; SnowClear = bright broken cumulus). Clear, fair, partly cloudy and other-realm weathers have no entries and the Baseline holds only the lightning switch. No Ground Fog entries. Read notes/install-pass-5.md first.
